notes: Explicit prayerKeys are editorial links for recurring prayer artwork pools. These do not approve artwork and are never inferred from the prayer date by the runtime.

Coverage-first 12 additional museum object candidates (8 Cleveland with archival originals, 1 Met, 3 NGA). CMA composite diptych requires iconographic review. Two CMA Assumption studies and a misassigned Presentation study are retained in acquisition archive only, not counted as direct artwork candidates.

Two Art Institute painted Pentecost records close the source-catalogue zero for rosary.glo3, but IIIF image downloads returned HTTP 403; original image quality is not verified. They are leads, not acquired paintings.

Batch-2 Met original JPEG acquisition produced 35 technically passing source-authenticated paintings; subjects tagged with caution for composites and patron saint identity. No artist/phone-crop review and no production promotion.

Pentecost 3 Commons originals acquired & SHA1-verified. Public Domain Mark / PD-Art is not CC0; per-image worldwide reuse rights not cleared. The Rosary 15-mystery 2-original availability milestone therefore does not mean 15/15 released or commercial-rights-cleared.

Sacred Heart and Immaculate Heart source-pool minima may use clearly captioned symbolically related Christ/Marian masterpiece; that is NOT an exact painted sacred/immaculate heart. Exact-iconographic works remain an independent acquisition/review target.
